policy.availability_component: 2025 missed-game share * sqrt(position durability R^2); no history uses position p75
policy.center_value_policy: exact deployed snapshot_values.compute_all_values value; never modified
policy.combination: root-sum-square of the three relative components
policy.history_component: sample standard error of active-game 2025 fantasy points divided by position median active-game PPG; <2 games uses position p75
policy.projection_component: abs(Sleeper-FantasyPros)/(Sleeper+FantasyPros), which is the provider half-spread divided by their mean; one-provider uses position median; zero-provider uses position p75
policy.tiers: quartiles of current-player relative half-width; descriptive, not probability levels
